title: nf-austin/scrnaseq samplesheet
description: One row per sample. Populate `fastq_dir` for standard Cell Ranger count runs, or `multi_config` when --run_flex is true.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and must not contain spaces
sample.description: Sample identifier, used for the Cell Ranger --id and the output subdirectory; must be unique. NOTE in Flex mode this names the *config*, and the per-sample outputs are keyed by the sample names Cell Ranger itself reports under per_sample_outs/, which come from the multi config rather than this column.

fastq_dir.description: Directory of 10x-style FASTQs for this sample. Required when --run_flex is false; ignored otherwise.

multi_config.errorMessage: multi_config must be a .csv path without spaces
multi_config.description: Cell Ranger multi config CSV. Required when --run_flex is true; ignored otherwise.
